intro: Google Sheets for nonprofit administrators on Mac is a standard tool for managing donor records, grant tracking, and volunteer schedules. You can use Lazur to help you navigate these complex spreadsheets without needing to memorize every menu or shortcut.

Nonprofit administrators often face heavy administrative tax, but keyboard shortcuts and voice assistance can help.

blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets as a Mac app

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac application. You can create a Progressive Web App shortcut to make it feel like one. Open Google Chrome and navigate to your spreadsheet. Click the three dot menu in the top right corner. Select Cast, Save, and Share. Choose Install page as app. This creates a dedicated window for your spreadsheet in your Dock.
Common keyboard shortcuts for nonprofit administrators

Save time by using your keyboard instead of your mouse. Press ⌘ + / to open the full list of shortcuts inside Google Sheets. Use ⌘ + ⇧ + H to find and replace text in your donor lists. Hide rows with ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 or columns with ⌘ + ⌥ + 0 when you need to clean up your view for a report.
Managing large datasets in Google Sheets

Nonprofit data grows quickly. You can now use up to 20 million cells per spreadsheet. If your sheet slows down, try to keep the number of active collaborators under 15. Too many editors at once often leads to sync conflicts and lag.
Reducing your administrative tax with Lazur

Administrative work takes up a large part of your week. You can hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where a specific setting is. Lazur will draw a circle and label on your screen. This helps you find menu items like conditional formatting or data validation without digging through submenus.
Using voice to dictate notes and reports

Nonprofit administrators write many case notes and grant updates. Hold the fn key to dictate text directly into your cells. This is faster than typing if you have a long update to record. Lazur keeps your text clean and formatted.
When to use Google Sheets versus other tools

Google Sheets is great for tracking and simple calculations. If you need to manage complex donor relationships, consider a dedicated CRM. Use Sheets for the data that does not fit in your CRM. Keep your workflows simple to avoid manual errors.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no official native app. You can install a shortcut through Google Chrome to create a dedicated window.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my Google Sheets files for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not edit files or click buttons. It guides you through the process by pointing at elements on your screen.

faq.question: How do I see all shortcuts for Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / while you are inside any Google Sheet to open the built in shortcut menu.

faq.question: Why is my Google Sheet running slowly?
faq.answer: Slow performance is often due to having too many active collaborators, complex formulas, or exceeding the cell limit.
